title: I've Been All Round This World

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Hang me oh hang me till I’m dead and gone
Hang me oh hang me till I’m dead and gone
One night hanging out just staying in jail too long
I been all ’round this world

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Workin’ on the new railroad mud up to my knees
Workin’ on the new railroad mud up to my knees
Workin’ for ol’ John Henry he’s mighty hard to please
I been all ’round this world

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Momma and papa and baby sister makes three
Momma and papa and baby sister makes three
Marchin’ me to the gallows that’ll be the end of me
I been all ’round this world

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: If you see a rich girl send her on down the line
If you see a rich girl send her on down the line
If you see a poor girl I’ll bet she’s a friend of mine
I been all ’round this world

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Up on Blueridge Mountain there I’ll make a stand
Up on Blueridge Mountain there I’ll make a stand
Rifle on my shoulder and a six shooter in my hand
I been all ’round this world

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Put the rope around my neck and hang me up so high
Put the rope around my neck and hung me up so high
Last words I heard 'em say, 'won't be long now 'fore you die, poor boy'
I been all ’round this world
